scope: Astra checked type/signature tables and finite scalar expression checker over BindingIndex; independent Vala production semantics and lowering remain authoritative

scalar/void/text.constructor: TypeTable fixed logical IDs 1..16; i32 aliases int
scalar/void/text.identity: canonical exact width/sign/format; isize/usize separate host-scope identities

struct/class/enum/type-parameter.identity: exact Binder SymbolId, whose original node/token/source span survives; no name-key type equality

generic applications.constructor: kind 34 with definition and ordered argument edges; checked_substitute
generic applications.identity: definition plus exact argument identities; storage fields do not contribute to type-expression depth
generic applications.later: general class/record storage capability proof, body specialization and inference require subsequent semantic authority

array/slice/slots.constructor: kinds 21/22/23; fixed extent belongs to array identity
array/slice/slots.later: nonliteral constant extents, transitive storage/copyability, slot construction and ownership flow

vector/mask.constructor: kind 24; element plus exact lane count
vector/mask.identity: numeric 128-bit shape or bool mask; no implicit broadcast
vector/mask.later: vector expression lowering and physical mask layout

nonnull.constructor: CheckedTypeUse.flags bit 1, same logical type as C0
nonnull.identity: qualifier preserved separately from ownership and type equivalence
nonnull.later: control-flow proof/refinement; a typed signature alone grants no nullability proof

shared/weak.identity: separate shared/weak and original Class declaration
shared/weak.later: intrusive/foreign policy, thread and lifetime rules

Fn/Callback/channels.constructor: kinds 25/26; result then ordered parameters with ownership bits
Fn/Callback/channels.identity: exact ordered type/channel identities, independent SignatureId for declarations
Fn/Callback/channels.later: general closure/record ownership proofs, escaping borrowed channels, checked closure environments; explicit channel identities are retained

task/executor/context.constructor: named deferred type uses; no invented success TypeId
task/executor/context.identity: Task escapes are excluded by C0; ContextBytes needs its declared Resource allocator contract
task/executor/context.later: nominated async/runtime/allocator contracts remain in Vala; syntax acceptance is not admission

foreign.identity: source nominal identity never asserts C/GObject/COM ABI identity
foreign.later: foreign type/policy admission, adapters and layout remain in Vala

expression_slice: known field projection and contextual aggregate field initializer

deferred_reasons.10: type constructor needs additional native/foreign/generic policy authority
deferred_reasons.11: constant array extent needs constant evaluation
deferred_reasons.12: member receiver or dispatch needs additional type/place authority
deferred_reasons.13: implicit receiver/value reference needs lifecycle context
deferred_reasons.14: function address needs an explicit callable expectation
deferred_reasons.15: expression depends on a specifically deferred operand or declaration
deferred_reasons.16: conversion requires nonscalar or ownership policy
deferred_reasons.17: intrinsic/member/generic call requires additional checked-call authority
deferred_reasons.100+SyntaxKind: specific unsupported expression/statement and its dependent subtree; original kind retained in every U row
deferred_reasons.18: nonnull destination needs a control-flow proof; declared qualifier retained
deferred_reasons.19: explicit owned/borrowed channel needs the later transfer/loan proof
deferred_reasons.20: contextual aggregate fields checked; full construction/completeness/storage proof remains pending

binder_seam.api: BindingIndex.complete_reference preserves original node/token/span/scope and updates reverse references
binder_seam.1: selected exact known nominal field receivers only; methods/properties/enum selection stay deferred
binder_seam.3: selected known destination aggregate fields only
binder_seam.4: match variant and payload selection remain deferred
binder_seam.7: known inferred Fn/Callback local selected over competing module callable

historical_status: Binder-4 remains accepted at its original revision. This ledger describes candidate scope; only current executed receipts establish qualification. No Stage 1 or full semantic compiler claim.
